courses.overview: 從「特斯拉與電動汽車工程」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.whyEn: Compare Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering with Toyota Prius hybrid vehicle: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 油電車和電池電動車都依賴逆變器、馬達、電池管理及再生制動。
related.transferEn: Hybrid and battery-electric vehicles both rely on inverters, motors, battery management and regenerative braking.
related.difference: Prius 具有引擎與動力分流；Tesla 電池電動車依靠外部充電和車載電池，運行與能量補給模型不同。
related.differenceEn: Prius combines an engine with power splitting; Tesla battery-electric vehicles use external charging and onboard batteries, producing different operating and replenishment models.
practice: 比較低速、巡航與制動情境

courses.summary:
Fremont 的故事是既有汽車工廠如何換上新的產品架構。Tesla 於 2010 年買下原 NUMMI 工廠，並在同年正式揭幕；2012 年 6 月 22 日，首批 Model S 在此交付客戶。這兩個時間點把場址取得、製造準備與真正交車分開。

電動車仍需要車身、裝配及品質驗證，但電池、電力電子、電機與熱管理改變了系統之間的關係。本課程以 Fremont 作為量產整合的代表案例，學習介面與可追溯性；不把這座工廠視為 Tesla 的全部產能，也不宣稱公開資料揭露完整製造參數。
courses.summaryEn:
Fremont tells a story of an existing automotive plant adapted to a new product architecture. Tesla acquired the former NUMMI factory in 2010 and unveiled it that year; the first Model S customers received cars there on June 22, 2012. These dates separate acquiring a site, preparing production, and delivering vehicles.

Electric vehicles still need body manufacture, assembly, and verification, while batteries, power electronics, motors, and thermal management change system relationships. The course uses Fremont as a representative integration case, not Tesla’s entire production network or a source of undisclosed manufacturing settings.

history.title: 既有工廠轉為電動車生產基地
history.titleEn: An existing factory is adapted for electric vehicles
history.text: Tesla 於 5 月買下原 NUMMI 廠，10 月揭幕 Fremont 工廠。
history.textEn: Tesla purchased the former NUMMI plant in May and unveiled the Fremont factory in October.

history.title: 首批 Model S 交付
history.text: 6 月 22 日在 Fremont 工廠交付首批 Model S，讓產品開發與製造準備連到客戶使用。
history.textEn: The first Model S deliveries at Fremont on June 22 connected product development and production preparation to customer use.

courses.connection: 在課程中把電池、逆變器、電機、冷卻與車身介面畫成系統圖；比較單件檢測與整車驗證，並追蹤版本、裝配紀錄及測試結果。
courses.connectionEn: Map battery, inverter, motor, cooling, and body interfaces. Compare component checks with vehicle-level verification and trace configuration, assembly records, and test results.
